title: Top-down rendered scene with robotic agents on metal-tiled floor
objects_and_counts: No people are visible in the photographed scene.
One eight-legged spider-like robot is visible near the image centre-left; its legs and body are largely unobscured.

At least three small turret-like robots are visible: two near the top-right corner adjacent to a cyan-blue glowing object, and one near the right edge; parts of some turrets are cropped by the image edges.
One cyan-blue glowing elongated object (appears to be a projectile or weapon effect) is visible near the top-right turret cluster.
One white-orange flame or muzzle flash effect is visible emanating from the spider-like robot toward the top-right.

Two wooden crate-like boxes are visible: one large open wooden crate occupies the bottom-left foreground and a second wooden box is visible at the bottom-right foreground (the latter is partially cropped).
Multiple floor tiles form a repeated grid of metal plates across the scene; individual tiles are visible and not counted as separate movable objects.
Bright yellow neon lines form angular barrier-like shapes on the floor in the top-left and top-right regions; sections of these lines are cropped by the image edges.
spatial_relations: The spider-like robot is located slightly left of image centre and is facing toward the top-right.
The cyan-blue elongated glowing object and two turret-like robots are positioned to the top-right of the spider-like robot.
A turret-like robot is visible near the right edge of the image, to the right of the floor-grid centre.
A large open wooden crate occupies the bottom-left foreground and is adjacent to the metal-tiled floor; a second wooden box sits in the bottom-right foreground partially cropped by the image edge.
Yellow neon lines form angular shapes crossing the top-left and top-right floor areas, running above the floor tiles and intersecting near the top-right cluster of turrets.
colours_and_materials: Floor is composed of grey metal tiles with darker seams and rivets between tiles.
Wooden crates are brown with visible grain; wood appearance is matte and textured.
Neon barrier lines are bright yellow with a glowing effect.
Projectile/effect colours include cyan-blue for the elongated glowing object and white-orange for the muzzle-flash or flame from the spider-like robot.
Overall scene lighting includes red/purple ambient tones on the floor and objects, producing colored reflections on the metal tiles.
uncertainties: The image appears to be a rendered or game scene; no equipment nameplates, room signs, or institutional identifiers for a physical facility are visible other than the on-image word 'SICARILIS'.
Exact counts for turret-like robots are uncertain where parts are cropped or partially obscured by image edges; I reported individually distinguishable turrets only.
No small labels, control panels, or other text were legible besides 'SICARILIS'; there may be additional unreadable or out-of-frame text.

Because this is a digital/fictional scene, objects that resemble equipment cannot be confirmed as real-world devices or give usable facility layout evidence for HKU Innovation Academy or Tam Wing Fan Innovation Wing.
